name: 77002 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77002 (Houston) has 345 nonprofit organizations. 150 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 125 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77002 (Houston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77002 (Houston) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
